设计意图： Mutation of drawdown_depth_atr_simple: shortens the lookback window from 63 to 21 days to increase responsiveness and potentially improve IC by capturing shorter-term drawdowns and mean-reversion opportunities. The core economic mechanism of contrarian drawdown depth normalized by ATR is preserved. The shorter window may increase signal frequency and turnover slightly, but the payoff structure is

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

depth = (ts_max(21, close) - close) / ts_max(21, close); factor = depth / ts_atr(high, low, close, 21)
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

depth = (ts_max(21, close) - close) / ts_max(21, close); factor = depth / ts_atr(high, low, close, 21)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. fillna —— 缺失值填充
    fillna(divide((-divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 21)), ts_max(AdjClose, 21))), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21)), 0)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide((-divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 21)), ts_max(AdjClose, 21))), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21))
  3. 3. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 21)), ts_max(AdjClose, 21))
  4. 4. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 21))
  5. 5. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(AdjClose, 21)
  6. 6. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(AdjClose, 21)
  7. 7. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21)
使用字段：
列含义说明
AdjClose后复权收盘复权后的收盘价，动量/收益类计算常用
AdjHigh后复权最高复权后的当日最高价
AdjLow后复权最低复权后的当日最低价

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 peak：close.滚动窗口(21, min_periods=21).max()
  2. 计算 dd：(close - peak) / peak
  3. 计算 depth：-dd
  4. 计算 atr_21：pd.Series(talib.ATR(high.values.astype(np.float64), low.values.astype(np.float64), close.values.astype(np.float64), timeperiod=21), index=df_copy.index)
  5. 计算 factor：depth / atr_21
  6. 计算 factor：factor
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_depth_atr_short_window(df): df_copy = df.copy() peak = df_copy["close"].rolling(21, min_periods=21).max() dd = (df_copy["close"] - peak) / peak depth = -dd atr_21 = pd.Series(talib.ATR(df_copy["str">'high'].values.astype(np.float64), df_copy["str">'low'].values.astype(np.float64), df_copy["str">'close'].values.astype(np.float64), timeperiod=21), index=df_copy.index) factor = depth / atr_21.replace(0, np.nan) factor = factor.fillna(0) df_copy["factor_drawdown_depth_atr_short_window"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_drawdown_depth_atr_short_window"]
